import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long N, K;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long[] Power = new long[65];
    static long[][] Res = new long[35][35];
    static long[][][][] S = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] A = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] P = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][] Aux = new long[35][35];
    static Pair<Long, Long>[] X = new Pair[105];

    static class Pair<L, R> {
        public L first;
        public R second;
        public Pair(L first, R second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void copyMatrix(long[][] X, long[][] Y, int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                X[i][j] = Y[i][j];
    }

    static void addMod(long[] x, long y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= MOD) x[0] -= MOD;
    }

    static void multiplyMatrices(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long[][] Z, int n, int m, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                Z[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    long val = (X[i][k] * Y[k][j]) % MOD;
                    addMod(new long[]{Z[i][j]}, val);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void precomputeA() {
        for (int x = 0; x < K; x++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) A[0][x][i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < K + 1; j++) A[0][x][j][x] = 1;
        }
        copyMatrix(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
        copyMatrix(S[0][K - 1], A[0][K - 1], K + 1);
        for (int x = 1; x < K; x++)
            multiplyMatrices(P[0][x - 1], A[0][x], P[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        for (int x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--)
            multiplyMatrices(A[0][x], S[0][x + 1], S[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        int cnt = 1;
        for (long m = K; m <= N; m *= K, cnt++) {
            for (int x = 0; x < K; x++) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], S[cnt - 1][x], K + 1);
                    multiplyMatrices(A[cnt][x], P[cnt - 1][x - 1], Aux, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                    copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], Aux, K + 1);
                } else {
                    copyMatrix(A[cnt][x], S[cnt - 1][x], K + 1);
                }
            }
            copyMatrix(P[cnt][0], A[cnt][0], K + 1);
            copyMatrix(S[cnt][K - 1], A[cnt][K - 1], K + 1);
            for (int x = 1; x < K; x++)
                multiplyMatrices(P[cnt][x - 1], A[cnt][x], P[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            for (int x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--)
                multiplyMatrices(A[cnt][x], S[cnt][x + 1], S[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            if (m > N / K) break;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        Power[0] = 1;
        int i = 1;
        while (Power[i - 1] <= N / K) {
            Power[i] = Power[i - 1] * K;
            i++;
        }
        int ind = i - 1;

        precomputeA();

        long init = N;
        long last = -1;
        long count = -1;
        int ind2 = 0;

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < 35; i2++)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < 35; j2++)
                Res[i2][j2] = 0;
        Res[0][K] = 1;

        for (int i2 = ind; i2 >= 0; i2--) {
            while (Power[i2] <= init) {
                long[][] ResCopy = new long[35][35];
                for (int a1 = 0; a1 < 35; a1++)
                    System.arraycopy(Res[a1], 0, ResCopy[a1], 0, 35);
                long[][] AuxTemp = new long[35][35];
                multiplyMatrices(Res, A[i2][ind2], AuxTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                for (int a1 = 0; a1 < 35; a1++)
                    System.arraycopy(AuxTemp[a1], 0, Res[a1], 0, 35);
                ind2++;
                if (ind2 == K) ind2 = 0;
                init -= Power[i2];
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i2 = 0; i2 <= K; i2++) {
            long[] temp = new long[]{ans};
            addMod(temp, Res[0][i2]);
            ans = temp[0];
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
